name: Workflow Display Node
description: On-demand Agent guide for presenting reports to the USER through Display nodes (HTML reports rendered fullscreen on the canvas).

whenToUse.trigger: When your task produces a report, research findings, comparison tables, decision summaries, or anything the USER should read on the canvas — and the user has NOT explicitly named a target file — write it to a Display node with display.write.
whenToUse.neverDo: Writing or modifying .html files is normal work and always allowed. But when presenting results: do not dump long reports into chat and never try to open a browser yourself — unless the user named a specific file, present through a Display node.

usage.write: display.write with a full self-contained HTML document (html param). The user opens the node fullscreen; the content runs with fully-open JS (same trust as your own terminal).
usage.read: display.read returns the current HTML plus this usage guide.
usage.revisionGuard: display.write accepts optional expectedRevision; a mismatch refuses the write so concurrent writers do not clobber each other.
usage.locking: markdown-style locks apply: acquire a lock before long multi-step edits; a lock held by another holder refuses writes.

theme.palette: White background, blue #2563EB, ink #111827, muted #6B7280, Claude yellow/terracotta #D97757 for accents.
theme.semanticClasses: Use semantic classes for the clean look: .report-title, .report-meta, .report-section, .card, .metric, .highlight, .muted, .badge. The default template already ships the full stylesheet — extend it, do not fight it.

diagrams.embedExcalidraw: Embed an Excalidraw node scene anywhere in the HTML with the placeholder {{excalidraw:<nodeId>}}. At serve time the backend expands it to a self-contained inline SVG (no CDN, no runtime JS) with a link to open the interactive node.
diagrams.findingNodeIds: Use excalidraw.readScene on the target node to confirm it exists; the placeholder needs the exact nodeId (e.g. component-diagram-abc123).

prohibitions: Never edit `Harness/a2a/**/state.json` directly — use typed actions.
Never edit component-node state files or the workflow map file.
Never open a browser or an HTML file yourself to present results — write to the Display node instead, unless the user named a specific file.
Never put secret or credential payloads in node actions; action payloads may be recorded.
